about_the_game:
Build Your City Freely

In a medieval world, use your imagination to freely build your own city. Gather and efficiently use basic resources like stone, wood, and iron to construct new buildings, improve your infrastructure, and turn your city into a strong economic center. Every building contributes to your city’s growth; your decisions and planning determine its fate.

Defend Against Wave Attacks

Your city becomes the target of enemy waves from time to time. To stop these attacks, you must build strategic towers and defensive structures and adapt your tactics for each assault. Enemy attacks grow increasingly difficult, so constantly strengthening your defenses and being prepared is the key to success.

Management and Public Happiness

Building a city isn’t just about structures; it’s up to you to meet your people’s needs and keep them happy. You must provide food, housing, health, and security, and complete missions from the kingdom to maintain social order. A happy and healthy population is the foundation of your city’s prosperity.

Challenging Natural Disasters

Nature can challenge your city from time to time. Earthquakes, storms, and other natural disasters can damage your city. It is your responsibility to take precautions and minimize the damage to protect your city. Nature’s power cannot be stopped, but being prepared ensures your city’s survival.

name: Towerfolk

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10,11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-9100 / i3-10100 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100 / Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or GTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10,11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Build your city and manage your people in a medieval setting. Overcome earthquakes and other challenging natural disasters, complete missions from the kingdom, and defend against waves of enemies. Use strategy and economic management to keep your city thriving
supported_languages: English, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Russian, Turkish
